title: HTTP client plugins
description:
Enterprise only. Inject your own Go HTTP client plugin, replacing the client KrakenD uses to call this backend. Only one plugin is supported per backend.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/extending/http-client-plugins/

config.title: Plugin configuration
config.description:
The configuration passed to the plugin. Its content depends on each plugin.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/extending/http-client-plugins/

name.title: Plugin name
name.description:
The name of the plugin to load. Only one plugin is supported per backend.

See: https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/extending/http-client-plugins/
